blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · The Women's Compression Calf Sleeve 2-…
blocks_element.text: The Women's Compression Calf Sleeve 2-Pack provides excellent compression and support, with many customers noting its perfect fit and high quality. The sleeves are designed to reduce fatigue and relieve soreness, making them ideal for both athletic and casual use. The breathable fabric and engineered airflow ensure comfort, though some customers have mixed opinions on the size.
Compression Level (11%): Customers appreciated the great compression provided by the compression socks, with many describing them as just right or amazing.
Product Quality (8%): Customers expressed appreciation for the high quality of the product, which was mentioned multiple times in the reviews.
Product Fit (12%): Customers expressed satisfaction with the fit of the product, with many describing it as perfect or great.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · "I bought these because I’ve been work…
blocks_element.text: "I bought these because I’ve been working on improving my running and usually get shin pain, but I wore these after working out for two days and already noticed a difference in how I felt while running. I know you can use them while running as well but I usually use them for recovery after a run or lifting. I’m definitely going to buy more and they are super easy to slip on and off."

blocks_element.repere: Intertitre · Love my Bombas calf Sleeves!!
Paragraphe · "I use these almost daily for work esp…
blocks_element.text: "I use these almost daily for work especially if I know I’ll be standing for most of the day. I also use them when I know I’m going to be sitting most of the day. I especially love using them when I go for a jog! My legs are short so these fit better than the regular socks. I actually bought the calf socks knowing the length of my legs are shorter than average. The sleeves are a little log but I make them work by not stretching them too much when putting them on. The width is good and true yo size, but the length is a little long for me."

blocks_element.repere: Intertitre · Added Comfort for Sales Floor!

blocks_element.text: "I work in retail and travel a ton. I found compression socks to be beneficial in both areas. These sleeves are invisible when I wear crop pants and clogs/sandals that do not require socks. My legs are less tired after hours on concrete floor!"
